limitations: four episodes and eight responses per condition
selection does not establish model equivalence

predeclared_selection_rule.choice: Among eligible settings, select the least expensive model according to retained provider token/cost evidence; if monetary cost is unavailable, use model tier then measured token use and latency as descriptive resource evidence.
eligible_setting: no more than one additional material-error response out of eight for any condition relative to that condition's best tested setting
aggregate specificity across F/G/H no more than 10 percentage points below the best tested setting
no more than one additional unsupported source attribution or causal overclaim across all 24 responses
substantive answer coverage at least 0.875 for every condition
predeclared_selection_rule.tie_or_ineligible: Retain gpt-5.6-sol low for the main study if Luna is ineligible or resource superiority cannot be established.

selection.rationale: Luna satisfies every predeclared quality margin and is the lower model tier; it also used fewer input/output tokens and lower aggregate latency. Monetary cost was not reported, so no dollar-cost claim is made.
